references.text: The verse mentions that Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus, which directly connects to the message in John 11:3 where the disciples send a message to Jesus saying that the one he loves is sick.
Although the verse emphasizes Jesus' love, it is immediately followed by a contrast in John 11:6 showing how this love is expressed by waiting two days before going.
Jesus' love for Lazarus and his family is clear in John 11:36 where the Jews comment: "See how he loved him!" as Jesus weeps at Lazarus' tomb.
Jesus' love for his friends is the basis for his actions in John 11:11, where he says that Lazarus has fallen asleep and that he will go to wake him up.
The introduction of the chapter in John 11:1 presents Lazarus from Bethany as the one Jesus loved, establishing the theme for the entire chapter.
